verses.1: Why do nations and peoples become bitter?
verses.2: The kings of the earth will stand together and plan together against Jehovah and His Messiah.
verses.3: I have taken away their responsibilities and thrown them aside from me.
verses.4: He who sits in heaven will laugh at Adonai. He will mock Lammo.
verses.5: Then his enemy will speak through his mouth and through his choices, and he will be terrified.
verses.6: And I was rescued by my king from the Holy Mountain.
verses.7: I reported to the LORD, “Son, today you will be my child.”
verses.8: Ask me, and I will give you the nations that are your inheritance and your possession.
verses.9: It will be destroyed by the iron, just as any creation can be destroyed.
verses.10: And now, when the kings became wise, the judges of the land were removed from their positions.
verses.11: Serve Jehovah with reverence and fear.
verses.12: They will be destroyed and perish along with those who are like a fire that burns everything in its path.
